records.label: BAB6950
records.segregation: Homozygous variant segregates with the phenotypes in the family
quotes: The proband (BAB6950) in family 058 with a potentially deleterious homozygous variant in MLLT1 presents with developmental delay, hypotonia, infantile spasm, and cortical dysgenesis

a In family 058, the proband (BAB6950) has developmental delay, hypotonia, and infantile spasms with diffuse brain atrophy, delay and hypomyelination, as well as malformation of cortical development. A homozygous variant in MLLT1 (NM_005934.3:c.1418G > A:p.Arg473Gln) is identified and segregates with the phenotypes in the family.

records.label: Sibs born to consanguineous Pakistani parents

phenotypes.text: neuropathologic findings consistent with neuroaxonal dystrophy

records.segregation: Both fetuses were homozygous for the BORCS5 variant and each parent was heterozygous. One fetus was also homozygous for the SCYL2 VUS, for which the parents were heterozygous.
quotes: We report on sibs, born to consanguineous Pakistani parents identified prenatally with cerebral ventriculomegaly and agenesis of the corpus callosum, and autopsies done on both showed similar abnormalities, including facial dysmorphism, osteopetrosis, and neuropathologic findings consistent with NAD.

Trio exome sequencing identified a homozygous c.283 C>T; p.(Arg95Ter) variant in exon 3 of the BORCS5 gene (NM_058169.4) in each of the couple's fetuses, and each of the parents was heterozygous for this variant.
Interestingly, one of the affected fetuses was also homozygous for a biallelic missense VUS variant in SCYL2 (NM_017988.5) c.902G>A; p. Arg301His, heterozygous in parents.

notes.statement: Fisher et al. (2025) found a homozygous SCYL2 missense VUS (Arg301His) in only one of two affected sib fetuses who carried a homozygous BORCS5 nonsense variant. Because the autopsy findings in the two sibs were identical, they raised the possibility that the SCYL2 variant did not contribute to the phenotype.
quotes: However, the autopsy findings on the two sibs were identical, raising the possibility that this SCYL2 homozygote variant did not contribute to the phenotype.

notes.statement: Fisher et al. (2025) noted that neuroaxonal dystrophy with osteopetrosis was first reported in a consanguineous Moroccan Jewish family. They also noted that, until their report, no genetic variant had been linked to the disease.
quotes: Neuroaxonal dystrophy (NAD) with osteopetrosis syndrome (OMIM # 600329) was first reported in a consanguineous Moroccan Jewish family. However, to date, no genetic variant has been linked to this disease.

notes.statement: Charng et al. (2016) noted that MLLT1 is an essential developmental gene that co-activates SWI/SNF complexes and regulates histone H3K79 demethylation. They suggested MLLT1 as a novel candidate disease gene, but they classified all variants in novel candidate genes as variants of uncertain significance.
quotes: MLLT1 is an essential gene during development that co-activates SWI/SNF complexes and regulates histone H3K79 demethylation.
we have categorized all variants in novel candidate disease genes as VUS
